objective: Fund execution of the THREE pre-approved FY2026 field-marketing conferences ONLY: DevWorld (San Francisco, Mar 2026), DataSummit (New York, Jun 2026), and CloudExpo (Austin, Sep 2026). Covered spend is strictly: booth and venue fees for those three events; the marketing team's business travel and lodging to attend those three events; approved swag and printed collateral produced for those three events; catering at our booth/sessions at those events; and paid advertising campaigns that promote OUR PRESENCE AT those three specific events. This mandate does NOT authorize: travel or lodging not tied to one of those three events (including sales kickoffs, customer visits, personal trips, or other conferences); sponsorship of or attendance at any event other than those three; net-new software, SaaS, or tools; hardware or equipment; recruiting, agency, or consultant retainers; general brand advertising not tied to the three events; employee perks, gifts, or team outings; or prepaying beyond the FY2026 event cycle.
